news.title: Pedestrian killed in Saturday night crash on Moreland Avenue
news.summary: A man died Saturday night after being struck by a vehicle while walking in the roadway near a DeKalb County intersection, according to police.

news.title: Person shot, seriously injured at metro Atlanta apartment, police investigating
news.summary: DeKalb police are investigating a shooting in Lithonia.

news.title: Zoo Atlanta mourns giant otter Bakairi after kidney failure diagnosis, death
news.summary: Zoo Atlanta announced sad news on Friday, sharing that giant otter Bakairi had passed away.

news.title: Police search for missing nonverbal 6-year-old boy at Clayton County apartments
news.summary: Police are continuing their search this morning for a missing nonverbal 6-year-old boy who was reported missing Saturday night from a Clayton County apartment complex.

news.title: Search underway for missing Clayton 6-year-old John Ross III
news.summary: Authorities and specialized units are scouring Clayton County to locate a nonverbal 6-year-old boy who disappeared Saturday evening.

news.title: Man injured in early morning shooting amid downtown Atlanta dispute, police say
news.summary: An early morning dispute in downtown Atlanta left one person injured, according to police. Investigators are examining what led to the shooting incident.

news.title: Man charged after allegedly placing toddler's body in Marietta woods
news.summary: A man is now facing charges in connection with the death investigation of a 2-year-old found near a Marietta apartment complex after he was reported missing Friday.

news.title: Clayton County Police urgently searching for missing 6-year-old nonverbal child
news.summary: According to authorities, Ross has a developmental disability and is nonverbal. He is about 4 feet 2 inches tall and weighs about 50 pounds.

news.title: Reward offered to identify individual in southwest Atlanta car break-ins
news.summary: Police are asking for the public's help identifying an individual captured on video targeting unlocked vehicles in southwest Atlanta earlier this week.

news.title: Marietta Police arrest mother's boyfriend in connection with 2-year-old's death
news.summary: 23-year-old Darian Keith was booked into the Cobb County Adult Detention Center, where he is facing charges of concealing a death and making false statements.
